service.name: Corporate sound bath
service.serviceType: Sound bath and sound healing for corporate wellness weeks, team building days, offsites, retreats, transition days, wedding weekends and bachelorettes
service.description: A seventy-five-minute group sound bath from Firstwater, a sound healing session brought to offices, offsites and retreats or held in a partner space in Denver, for companies, event planners, hospitals, hospices, libraries, schools and conference organizers across Denver, the Front Range and the Colorado mountain corridor.

faqs.q: What is a corporate sound bath?
faqs.a: A group sound bath brought to a company: seventy-five minutes with your people lying down in low light under blankets, live instruments played over composed music, real silence partway through, and a ceremony to open and close it. Nobody has to speak, share or do anything but lie down. Some people call it sound healing or sound meditation, and it's the same session.

faqs.q: Can Firstwater bring a sound bath to our office or offsite venue?
faqs.a: Yes. Firstwater brings the sound system, the mats, the blankets and the waivers to your venue, or the session runs in a partner space in Denver. If you have a space, Firstwater can make it sound like a different one.

faqs.q: How much space does a sound bath need?
faqs.a: Enough floor for your people to lie down, a standard outlet, and about ninety minutes ahead of doors. Everything else, from the mats to the waivers, arrives with the facilitator.

faqs.q: Do people have to do anything during a sound bath?
faqs.a: They lie down, and everything else is optional. Some people follow the guidance closely, some drift and some sleep, and each of those is a fine way to spend the hour. Nobody is asked to share, to speak, or to be anywhere but on the floor, and if the facilitator offers an invitation during the session, people hear about it beforehand and it's optional.

faqs.q: Does a sound bath work for team building or a corporate retreat?
faqs.a: Yes, at the close of an evening or the start of a morning. Firstwater builds one or more sessions into the agenda with you, and a team that has spent the day in meetings gets seventy-five minutes together with nothing to do and nothing to say.

faqs.q: Can Firstwater do a sound bath for a wedding or a bachelorette?
faqs.a: Yes. A private sound bath for the wedding party, the bachelorette, or the couple, at the house you rented, your venue, or a partner space in Denver, as the welcome evening, the morning of, or the day after. The details are on the weddings page of Firstwater's own site.
